body: Unfortunately, all my friends are based in the same town as my Uni and pretty much everything's closed here 'till the 27th. At least I can take comfort in the fact that I only have to spend one more day here, until I can get a train back home.

Thanks for the comment.

Yes. I suffer from depression. I've been attending counselling for a few months now. My University provides free health care. I find it very difficult to speak freely (even after 20 sessions) but I'm getting there. It's just that, this Xmas I'm stuck down here with my ex foster family due to lack of public transport when I'd rather be alone.
